# Các type App Bridge {#app-bridge-types}

Các type được dùng trên các trang App Bridge, cùng mọi type mà chúng tham chiếu, lấy từ [`@shopify/app-bridge-types`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/app-bridge-types) 0.7.5. `polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge` re-export những type mà package export. Phần mô tả là JSDoc của chính Shopify, giữ nguyên tiếng Anh.

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">sidekick</span>: <a href="/vi/app-bridge/types/user-interface-and-interactions#sidekickapi">SidekickApi</a></code></p>

Start Sidekick conversations for the merchant from your app.

`shopify.sidekick` is always defined, but its methods reject when Sidekick isn't available to the app, for example in the Shopify mobile app or on a store without Sidekick. Feature-detect with `isEnabled()` and treat a rejection as unavailable.

</div>

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">tools</span>: <a href="/vi/app-bridge/types/user-interface-and-interactions#tools">Tools</a></code></p>

Entry point for Shopify tools.

Enables apps to bind runtime handler functions for tools already declared in app extension configuration, which can be invoked by the platform on behalf of the app. Registered tools are scoped to the current app and persist for the lifetime of the app or until explicitly removed.

</div>
